svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 2 — Panel 1: Bridge wide, OTS Sable, full squad
svg.desc: Wide shot from slightly elevated angle, OTS Sable. Compact military bridge interior — submarine-cockpit cramped, narrow rectangular viewports, every surface functional. Sable foreground (back of silver-suited shoulder + back of silver-white cropped head). Wren at engineering console left in copper. Luma at science station right in sapphire-violet. Jink slouched in jump seat center-back in emerald. Through corridor archway behind, Thresh visible at weapon station in ruby. Multiple holographic displays float at varying heights — overlapping pools of department-colored geometric light: blue-white command, copper-gold engineering, blue-violet science. Professional routine. SABLE: "Standard reconnaissance protocol. In and out, minimal footprint. We observe the convergence point, tag the temporal markers, and extract. Nothing more."
